title: Jubilees 9 — The sub-allotments of Noah's grandsons and the oath of binding

translation.sourceText: Jubilees — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction. Ge'ez primary (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511); Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus, ed. Dean 1935) preserves portions of the sub-allotment material. 11Q12 not preserved at this chapter.
translation.sourceLicense: Best-effort reconstruction; scholarly editions cited; English original to this project
translation.sourceAccessedVia: Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511 + Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Alexander 1982 JJS 33; Scott 2002 Geography in Early Judaism
translation.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Dean 1935 Epiphanius + VanderKam Ge'ez critical apparatus

paragraphs.text: ወከፈለ፡ ሐም፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኩሽ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ለምሥር፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለፉጥ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለከንዓን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ባሕር፡

i18n.en: And Ham divided his land among his sons; and the first lot came forth for Cush toward the east, and to the west of him for Mizraim, and to the west of him for Put, and to the west of him for Canaan — westward unto the sea.

paragraphs.text: ወከፈለ፡ ሴም፡ ካዕበ፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኤላም፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ ፈለግ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ሕንድ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወውስተ፡ ማየ፡ ዳዲሽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ኤትዮ፡ ምድር፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካን፡ ዘፋርስ፡ ወቤትሰዐድ፡

i18n.en: And Shem also divided his land among his sons; and the first lot came forth for Elam — what lies toward the east, from the river Tigris until it reaches eastward through all the land of India, and into the Erythraean Sea beside it, and to the waters of Dadish, and it proceeds northward, and it proceeds until it arrives at the land of Etyo, and toward the region of Persia and Beth-Saad.

paragraphs.text: ወለአሱር፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ካልእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ አሱር፡ ወነነዌ፡ ወሺንዐራ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ብሔር፡

i18n.en: And to Asshur came the second lot: all the land of Assyria, and Nineveh, and Shinar, and unto the land of the Euphrates.

paragraphs.text: ወለአርፋክስድ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሣልስ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ብሔረ፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ማያተ፡ ገዳም፡ እስከ፡ ቀርብት፡ ለላዕለ፡ ለማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ባሕር፡ መንገለ፡ ምድረ፡ ሐም፡

i18n.en: And to Arpachshad came the third lot: all the land of the country of the Chaldeans, east of the Euphrates, beside the Erythraean Sea, and all the desert waters, as far as near the region above the middle of the eastern sea — toward the land of Ham.

paragraphs.text: ወለአራም፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ መሶጶታምያ፡ ማእከለ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ ወኤፍራጥስ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ደብር፡ አሱር፡ ወምድር፡ አራራት፡

i18n.en: And to Aram came the fourth lot: all the land of Mesopotamia between the Tigris and the Euphrates, toward the north, from the land of the Chaldeans until it reaches the mountain of Asshur and the land of Ararat.

paragraphs.text: ወለሊዶ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ደብር፡ ኤሳው፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘያቀርብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መንገለ፡ ካሬያ፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካናተ፡ መንገለ፡ ቆስታ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡

i18n.en: And to Lud came the fifth lot: the mountain of Esau, and all the land that is adjacent to it, toward Caria, and toward the regions toward Cilicia, and toward the west.

paragraphs.text: ወከፈለ፡ ያፌት፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለጎሜር፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ይከይድ፡ ለመክፈልቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘመጋጎግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡

i18n.en: And Japheth divided his land among his sons; and the first lot came forth for Gomer toward the east, from the northern side toward the river Tina; and his lot proceeds northward, all the land of Magog toward the east, which proceeds in all its course toward the east.

paragraphs.text: ወለማዳይ፡ ወፅአ፡ መካን፡ ለመክፈልት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡

i18n.en: And to Madai came his portion: he was placed eastward of the river Tina, toward the land — to the west of the river Tina.

paragraphs.text: ወለያዋን፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደሰያት፡ ወደሰያት፡ ቅሩብ፡ ለሊዶ፡

i18n.en: And to Javan came the fourth lot: all the islands, and the islands that are adjacent to Lud.

paragraphs.text: ወለቱባል፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ማእከለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡

i18n.en: And to Tubal came the fifth lot: the middle region that extends toward the north, toward the west, toward the land of Beth-Farama.

paragraphs.text: ወለሞሰሐ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳድስ፡ መንገለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡

i18n.en: And to Meshech came the sixth lot: the region that extends toward the land of Beth-Farama, and toward what proceeds westward.

paragraphs.text: ወለቲራስ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳብዕ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ደሰያት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡

i18n.en: And to Tiras came the seventh lot: four great islands in the midst of the sea, which extend toward the land of Ham.

paragraphs.text: ወከመዝ፡ ከፈልዎ፡ ለምድር፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወአምሐልዎሙ፡ መሐለ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኪደ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ መሐለ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መርገመ፡ ለለ፡ ዘይዘምድ፡

i18n.en: And in this manner the sons of Noah divided the land among themselves before Noah their father; and he bound them by an oath, an oath against every man who would trespass upon the lot that had come forth to him — all of them swore an oath, a curse upon every one who would do so.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤልዎ፡ አሜን፡ አሜን፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ በዕለታት፡ ኩናኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡

i18n.en: And they said to him: Amen, Amen — both for him and for his sons forever — that it should fall upon them in the days of judgment that it be done to every one who would trespass upon the lot that had come forth to him, upon him and upon his sons forever.

paragraphs.text: ወባረኮሙ፡ ኖኅ፡ አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወባረከ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ዘፈለጠ፡ ለሎሙ፡ ዕፆሙ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለዓለም፡

i18n.en: And Noah blessed them — the God of heaven — upon all his sons; and he blessed the Lord who had divided their lots for them, and he established a covenant with them forever.
